purpose: Provides income support to eligible farmer families through the prescribed direct-benefit mechanism.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families are identified under central guidelines, subject to exclusions and land-record verification.
benefits: Provides notified income-support instalments through DBT when conditions are satisfied; eKYC is required on the official portal.
application_process: Register or update details on the PM-KISAN portal, through a State or Union Territory agriculture department, or an authorised CSC.

purpose: Provides crop-insurance coverage against specified crop and weather-related risks.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas may be covered, subject to season, crop, state notification, and policy conditions.
benefits: Insurance protection and admissible claims are governed by the notified policy, loss assessment, and applicable terms; no claim amount is guaranteed.
application_process: Apply through the official portal, participating bank or PACS, insurance company, or authorised channel during the applicable enrolment period.

purpose: Facilitates institutional agricultural credit for cultivation and related farming needs.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, self-help groups, and joint-liability groups may qualify according to lender and scheme rules.
benefits: Provides a sanctioned revolving credit facility subject to appraisal, limits, interest rules, repayment, and lender conditions.
application_process: Apply at a participating commercial bank, regional rural bank, cooperative bank, or the lender's official digital channel.

purpose: Expands irrigation coverage and promotes efficient water use, including Per Drop More Crop.
eligibility: Farmers and implementing entities may benefit through components selected and administered by the relevant State or Union Territory agency.
benefits: May support irrigation, water-use efficiency, watershed, or related interventions approved under the applicable component.
application_process: Apply through the State agriculture, horticulture, irrigation, watershed, or designated implementing department.

purpose: Provides soil-test-based information and recommendations for balanced nutrient management.
eligibility: Farmers whose fields are sampled through the government soil-testing system may receive a card or report.
benefits: Provides soil-test results and crop-specific nutrient recommendations; it is not itself a guaranteed cash benefit.
application_process: Contact the local agriculture department, soil-testing laboratory, or use the official Soil Health portal.

purpose: Links participating agricultural markets through an electronic trading and price-discovery platform.
eligibility: Farmers, traders, commission agents, FPOs, and other market participants may participate where their market is integrated and registration is accepted.
benefits: Can provide electronic bidding, wider market access, price discovery, and transaction-related services subject to APMC and platform rules.
application_process: Register through an e-NAM mandi, State or Union Territory market authority, FPO channel, or the official platform.

purpose: Promotes decentralised renewable-energy applications, including solar agriculture pumps and renewable power generation.
eligibility: Farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, panchayats, and other categories may qualify under the relevant component and State or Union Territory notification.
benefits: May provide approved financial support or facilitate installation or use of renewable-energy systems, subject to component guidelines and state implementation.
application_process: Apply through the State renewable-energy or agriculture implementing agency listed on the National Portal.

purpose: Supports financing for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets.
eligibility: Eligible farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs, startups, and approved entities may apply for eligible projects.
benefits: Provides access to eligible institutional financing and scheme-linked support subject to project appraisal, lending, and guideline conditions.
application_process: Submit a project through the official AIF portal and participating lending institution.

purpose: Promotes cluster-based organic farming and related certification and value-chain activities.
eligibility: Farmer groups or clusters selected under State or Union Territory implementation arrangements may participate.
benefits: May support organic-farming inputs, training, certification, documentation, and market-linkage activities approved under the scheme.
application_process: Approach the State agriculture department, district agriculture office, or designated cluster agency.

purpose: Encourages climate-resilient, resource-efficient, and sustainable agricultural practices.
eligibility: Farmers and implementing entities may qualify through components notified and administered by States or Union Territories.
benefits: May support approved interventions relating to soil, water, farm management, or climate resilience; benefits vary by component.
application_process: Apply through the State agriculture department or implementing agency.

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
purpose: Provides a legal framework for demand-driven wage employment and creation of rural assets.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to undertake unskilled manual work may request registration and employment, subject to the Act and local process.
benefits: Provides employment and wages for approved works according to the Act, muster-roll records, and applicable wage notifications.
application_process: Register and demand work through the Gram Panchayat, Programme Officer, or official MGNREGA channels.

purpose: Supports housing assistance for eligible rural households lacking an adequately habitable house.
eligibility: Beneficiaries are selected through the prescribed deprivation-based and administrative verification process.
benefits: Provides housing assistance and related convergence support according to approved norms and instalment conditions.
application_process: Beneficiary identification is normally through Gram Panchayat or State rural-development authorities; status can be checked on the official system.

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
purpose: Organises rural poor households, especially women, into self-help groups and supports sustainable livelihoods.
eligibility: Rural poor households and community institutions may participate through State Rural Livelihoods Missions.
benefits: May provide social mobilisation, training, financial-inclusion, enterprise, and livelihood support through SHG institutions.
application_process: Contact the State Rural Livelihoods Mission, block mission unit, village organisation, or SHG federation.

purpose: Improves all-weather rural road connectivity to eligible habitations.
eligibility: This is primarily an infrastructure programme; eligibility is determined for habitations and roads under programme guidelines rather than individual applications.
benefits: Provides improved road connectivity and related rural access; it is not normally an individual cash-benefit scheme.
application_process: Submit road or connectivity representations through the Gram Panchayat, district rural-roads agency, or State implementing department.

purpose: Works toward safe and adequate drinking-water supply through rural household tap connections and source sustainability.
eligibility: Rural households and habitations are covered through State or Union Territory and village-level implementation plans.
benefits: May provide household tap-water connections, village water infrastructure, and water-quality or source-sustainability measures as approved.
application_process: Approach the Gram Panchayat, Village Water and Sanitation Committee, or State rural-water-supply department.

purpose: Supports rural sanitation, ODF sustainability, and solid and liquid waste management.
eligibility: Rural households and local bodies may be covered under State or Union Territory implementation plans and prescribed eligibility checks.
benefits: May support sanitation facilities, cleanliness infrastructure, and waste-management activities under current programme guidelines.
application_process: Apply or seek inclusion through the Gram Panchayat, block office, district programme unit, or State SBM-G portal.

purpose: Provides social-assistance pensions and family-benefit support to eligible vulnerable households.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the particular NSAP component, age or status criteria, household circumstances, and State or Union Territory verification.
benefits: Provides notified social assistance under the relevant component; amounts and procedures can vary by component and State or Union Territory.
application_process: Apply through the Gram Panchayat, municipality, district social-welfare office, or designated State portal.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
purpose: Facilitates formal working-capital support and digital or financial inclusion for eligible street vendors.
eligibility: Street vendors covered by the applicable survey, certificate, letter of recommendation, and notified State or Union Territory rules may apply.
benefits: Provides access to scheme-linked working-capital lending and associated incentives subject to lender approval and current guidelines.
application_process: Apply through the official portal, urban local body, Common Service Centre, or participating lending institution.

purpose: Promotes access to basic bank accounts and financial services for unbanked or underserved persons.
eligibility: Individuals without an existing suitable basic bank account may approach a participating bank, subject to KYC and banking rules.
benefits: Enables access to basic banking and, where separately eligible, linked financial services and DBT receipt.
application_process: Open an account at a participating bank branch, Bank Mitra or Business Correspondent, or other authorised channel.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
purpose: Offers renewable life-insurance cover through participating banks, post offices, and insurers.
eligibility: Eligible account holders within the scheme's prescribed age, consent, enrolment, and auto-debit conditions may join.
benefits: Provides life-insurance benefit to the nominee on an admissible claim, subject to policy exclusions and terms.
application_process: Enrol through the participating bank, post office account provider, or its authorised digital channel.

purpose: Offers renewable personal-accident insurance through participating account providers.
eligibility: Eligible account holders meeting the prescribed age, consent, enrolment, and auto-debit requirements may join.
benefits: Provides accident-related insurance benefits for covered events, subject to policy definitions, exclusions, and claim procedure.
application_process: Enrol through a participating bank, post office, or authorised account-service channel.

purpose: Encourages pension savings for eligible subscribers, particularly workers outside formal pension coverage.
eligibility: Indian citizens meeting the scheme's entry, age, bank-account, and contribution conditions may subscribe, subject to current rules.
benefits: Provides a pension-related benefit according to the selected contribution option and applicable APY rules.
application_process: Maintain an eligible bank account and enrol through the bank, post office, or authorised APY channel.

purpose: Facilitates institutional credit for micro and small non-farm enterprises and income-generating activities.
eligibility: Micro-enterprises and eligible entrepreneurs may apply through participating lenders, subject to credit appraisal and scheme criteria.
benefits: Provides access to eligible business loans and related credit support; sanction, pricing, collateral, and repayment depend on the lender and product.
application_process: Apply at a participating bank, regional rural bank, microfinance institution, NBFC, or official lender channel.

purpose: Facilitates bank finance for eligible SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs establishing greenfield enterprises.
eligibility: SC or ST borrowers and women entrepreneurs meeting scheme and lender conditions may apply; non-individual entities must satisfy ownership and control requirements.
benefits: Provides access to composite bank finance and handholding support subject to appraisal and scheme rules.
application_process: Apply through the Stand-Up Mitra portal, scheduled commercial bank branch, or designated handholding agency.

purpose: Supports creation of micro-enterprises and employment through credit-linked assistance.
eligibility: Individuals and eligible institutions or groups may apply for admissible new projects subject to PMEGP guidelines and bank appraisal.
benefits: May provide credit-linked margin-money assistance and entrepreneurship support; final finance depends on project and lender approval.
application_process: Apply through the official PMEGP e-portal, KVIC, KVIB, DIC implementing agency, and participating bank.

purpose: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople through recognition, skills, tools, credit, and market-related assistance.
eligibility: Artisans in notified traditional trades may register subject to trade, identity, age, household, and verification conditions.
benefits: May include certificate or ID, training, toolkit or digital support, credit facilitation, and market linkage under current guidelines.
application_process: Register through a Common Service Centre and complete the prescribed Gram Panchayat or ULB and departmental verification.

purpose: Provides employment, job-matching, counselling, career-content, and job-fair services.
eligibility: Jobseekers, employers, counsellors, skill providers, and other listed users may register for relevant services.
benefits: Provides access to job listings, career guidance, counselling, job fairs, and related services; registration and applications are free according to the portal.
application_process: Register and use services on the NCS portal or official mobile application, or visit a Career Centre.

scheme_name: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
purpose: Enables citizens to lodge and track grievances concerning public-authority service delivery.
eligibility: Any citizen may submit a service-delivery grievance, subject to exclusions such as sub judice, RTI, and specified personnel matters.
benefits: Provides registration-ID tracking, departmental handling, feedback, and appeal functionality where applicable.
application_process: File online at CPGRAMS, through the official mobile or UMANG integration, or through an assisted government service channel.

scheme_name: National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) assistance programmes
purpose: Provides financial and developmental assistance for eligible cooperative-sector activities.
eligibility: Eligible cooperatives and cooperative federations apply under the relevant NCDC programme and sector guidelines.
benefits: May provide loans, grants, or project assistance under the applicable NCDC programme, subject to appraisal and sanction.
application_process: Apply through the concerned State or Union Territory Cooperative Department, cooperative federation, or NCDC prescribed route.

scheme_name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) and Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS)
purpose: Provides subsidised foodgrain entitlements and related food-security mechanisms to eligible households.
eligibility: Eligibility and household identification are administered under NFSA and State or Union Territory beneficiary rules.
benefits: Provides access to entitled foodgrain and related portability or grievance services where available, subject to current rules and allocation.
application_process: Apply for or update a ration card through the State or Union Territory food and civil-supplies portal, fair-price shop, or designated office.
